remarks: Welcome to The Maritime, a luxurious, high rise condo complex situated on the water in the heart of South Norwalk. The Maritime Complex and its neighborhood has anything and everything you ever wished for and within walking distance too! You will have easy access to some of the best restaurants in Fairfield county as well as parks, beaches, art galleries, boutique shops, aquariums, train station, malls & much more! This exceptional, spacious apartment which is brimming with light has big city feel without all the hustle and bustle! As you enter unit 206 you will notice the ample light along with the open floor plan which highlights the spacious living room and dine in kitchen with granite countertops & matching stainless steel appliances along with abundant cabinet & pantry storage. The master bedroom offers an amazing walk in closet with washer and dryer and floor to ceiling windows for you to wake up every day to the beautiful views of historic SONO. Enjoy the amenities at the Maritime which include a fully equipped gym, recreation room with kitchenette and fireplace, a conference room plus underground parking garage. Come visit Sono's premier condo complex at The Maritime and get a true feel for what living in historic downtown Sono and within walking distance everything & anything you could ever dream of!
